coverage_notes: Exhaustive Phase A sweep across 6 major angles covering market sizing, competitive landscape, pain points, and HCI research: (1) DATA VISUALIZATION MARKET—USD 10.92B (2025) to USD 18.36B (2030), 10.95% CAGR, vendor leadership (Tableau 12.88%, Power BI 13.47%, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle), cloud 56.2% share. (2) LOW-CODE/NO-CODE PLATFORMS—Gartner USD 58.2B by 2029 (14.1% CAGR), Forrester Wave 2025 leaders (Microsoft, OutSystems, Creatio), market USD 65B to USD 94B (26.1% CAGR), barriers: vendor lock-in, skill gaps (52%), integration complexity. (3) RAG/WORKFLOW-GRAPH TOOLS—GraphRAG peer-reviewed (arXiv), platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier, LangChain, Dify), cost 10-100x savings vs custom. (4) DATABASE VISUALIZATION—NoSQL (MongoDB Charts), graph DBs (Neo4j Bloom), DBA monitoring, pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Dagster). (5) COMPETITIVE LANDSCAPE—internal tools (Retool, Bubble, FlutterFlow, Glide), analytics (Metabase, Looker, Superset), embedded analytics 80% preferred 2026. (6) PAIN POINTS & HCI—data trust 47%, skills 52%, metro-map UX (octilinear), vendor lock-in risks, professional developer adoption 13.7%. Tier: 35 T0, 28 T1, 24 T2, 12 T3. Deduplicated 40+ searches.
